q: 1. If the variation exceeds the 15% of contract amount, then variation order is approved by ........
explain: As per the answer key, variations above 15% need approval from the secretary of the concerned ministry.

q: 2. Security deposits deducted from the contractor's bill is ........
options: refunded when defect liability period is over
refunded upon the completion of work
refunded when good progress is achieved
retained until the life span of project
explain: Retention money guards against defects, so it is released after the defect liability period ends.

q: 3. While procuring the consulting services, RFP is extended to ........
options: all the bidders who submitted EOI
qualified short listed bidders from EOI
explain: After EOI evaluation and short listing, the RFP is sent only to the shortlisted firms.

q: 4. Which of the following is the logical flow of any project?
explain: The standard project management process groups run in this order: initiation, planning, executing, controlling, closing.
